source: WOMAN trial (PMID 28456509, PMC5446563) full text, Table 5: 'Thromboembolic events | 10 033 | 9985 | Any event 30 (0.3%) | 34 (0.3%) | 0.88 (0.54-1.43) | 0.603'. Per-arm any-thromboembolic-event counts (normalised denominators for the thromboembolic analysis): 30 of 10033 (tranexamic acid) vs 34 of 9985 (placebo). Tranexamic acid vs placebo in women with a clinical diagnosis of postpartum haemorrhage (treatment). WOMAN is this topic's sole pooled trial (the primary is k=1 WOMAN; the other TXA-PPH trials are PREVENTION, correctly declined), so this thromboembolic harm is the representative single-trial estimate for the treatment PICO.
